stardewcraft.mail.friendshipRecipeShaneS:
Dear @,

I've enclosed my recipe for Strange Bun. I hope you enjoy it.

—Shane
stardewcraft.mail.friendshipRecipeWillyC:
Dear @,

I've enclosed my recipe for Chowder. I hope you enjoy it.

—Willy
stardewcraft.mail.friendshipRecipeWillyE:
Dear @,

I've enclosed my recipe for Escargot. I hope you enjoy it.

—Willy
stardewcraft.mail.friendshipRecipeWillyF:
Dear @,

I've enclosed my recipe for Fish Stew. I hope you enjoy it.

—Willy
stardewcraft.mail.friendshipRecipeWillyL:
Dear @,

I've enclosed my recipe for Lobster Bisque. I hope you enjoy it.

—Willy
stardewcraft.mail.guildQuest: I see you've been exploring the old mine. You've got the adventurer's spirit, that much I can tell.^If you can slay 10 slimes, you'll have earned your place in my adventurer's guild. ^Be careful.    -Marlon %item quest 15 true %%[#]Quest To Slay Slimes
stardewcraft.mail.gusRecipe:
Hi @,

I'm Gus, chef and owner of the saloon.

I've developed a new recipe that's perfect for a busy farmer. Stop by the saloon and I'll teach it to you!

—Gus
stardewcraft.mail.hospitalDeath:
@,

Someone brought you to the clinic after you passed out!

I've treated your injuries. Please take better care of your health.

—Dr. Harvey
stardewcraft.mail.joja_welcome:
Hello @!

Joja Corporation welcomes you as our newest neighbor!

Don't forget to visit JojaMart—our prices can't be beat!*

*Actual results may vary.
—Morris
stardewcraft.mail.levelUp_farming_2:
Hi @,

Congratulations on improving your farming skill!

As your skill grows, so will the quality of your crops. Keep it up!

—Mayor Lewis
stardewcraft.mail.levelUp_fishing_2:
@,

Your fishing is getting better!

The higher your skill, the more kinds of fish you'll be able to catch. Keep practicing!

—Willy
stardewcraft.mail.levelUp_foraging_2:
Hey @,

You're learning more and more about wild plants.

As your foraging skill improves, you'll find higher-quality wild items.

—Linus
stardewcraft.mail.levelUp_mining_2:
Dear @,

I heard your mining skill has improved again.

A higher mining skill means you'll get more from every ore vein.

—Clint
stardewcraft.mail.linusTip:
@,

I've lived in the mountains for many years and learned a few survival tricks.

Watch the ground as you walk. Sometimes you can dig up useful things.

—Linus
stardewcraft.mail.linusTrash:
Dear @,

Rummaging through trash may not sound dignified, but you wouldn't believe what people throw away.

Check the town's trash cans when you pass by... just don't let anyone see you!

—Linus
stardewcraft.mail.marlonRecovery:
@,

I found some of your lost belongings near the mine entrance. Come by the Adventurer's Guild and I can recover one item for you, for a fee.

—Marlon
stardewcraft.mail.marnieAnimal:
Hey @,

Interested in raising animals? I sell all sorts of livestock at my ranch.

Chickens, ducks, cows, sheep... all you need is a coop or barn!

—Marnie
stardewcraft.mail.mineDeath_Clint:
@,

I found you passed out in the mines. I nearly threw out my back dragging you up.

Be more careful next time.

—Clint
stardewcraft.mail.mineDeath_Linus:
@,

I found you unconscious on the path near the mines. You're lucky I happened to pass by!

The creatures in the mines are dangerous. Don't push yourself too far.

—Linus
stardewcraft.mail.mineDeath_Maru:
@,

I found you near the mine entrance, and you were badly hurt. I gave you some basic medical treatment.

Please be careful in the mines!

—Maru
stardewcraft.mail.mineDeath_Robin:
@,

I found you unconscious in the mines. I almost hauled you home thinking you were some exotic lumber!

Anyway, I brought you home. You may have lost a few things.

—Robin
stardewcraft.mail.mom1: Dear @,^  How are you doing, sweety? I've missed you so much since you left. I hope the farming life is everything you hoped for. ^   Love, Mom.   ^   P.S. I sent your favorite cookies < %item id (O)223 1 %%[#]From Mom
stardewcraft.mail.mom2: Dear @,^  It's been so long since I heard from you, dear. Things are the same as ever back home. I miss you very much. ^  Love, Mom ^ P.S. Found an envelope with some money Grandpa left for you. %item money 500 501 %%[#]From Mom #2
stardewcraft.mail.mom3: Dear @,^  I saw an article about you in the local paper! It sounds like the country life is a good fit for you! I'm so proud of you. Take care, sweety. Love, Mom[#]From Mom #3
stardewcraft.mail.mom4: Dear @,^ How are things going? You must really be making a fortune on that farm. Don't forget your dear old mother when you're a millionaire! ^  Love, Mom   ^   P.S. Enjoy the cake!%item id (O)221 1 %%[#]From Mom #4
stardewcraft.mail.passedOut_Harvey:
@,

Someone brought you to the clinic. You passed out from exhaustion!

Remember to get home earlier and don't overwork yourself.

—Dr. Harvey
stardewcraft.mail.passedOut_Linus:
@,

It's a good thing I found you last night! You had collapsed outside.

I saw someone going through your pockets... I don't know how much money they took.

—Linus
stardewcraft.mail.passedOut_Marlon:
@,

I found you face-down in the dirt during my early-morning patrol and dragged you home.

Get home earlier next time!

—Marlon
stardewcraft.mail.passedOut_Joja:
Dear @,

Last night, a Joja team member found you incapacitated. A medical team was dispatched to bring you home safely.

We're glad you're okay! Any applicable service fee has already been deducted.

—Morris
Joja Customer Satisfaction Representative
stardewcraft.mail.pierreGeneral:
Hi @,

I've just stocked some new seeds. Come take a look!

Remember, every season has different crops, so buy your seeds early.

—Pierre
stardewcraft.mail.robinBarn:
Hi @,

If you want to raise cows or goats, you'll need a barn.

Just bring enough wood and gold to my shop!

—Robin
stardewcraft.mail.robinCoop:
@,

I noticed your farm doesn't have a coop yet.

If you want chickens, come see me about building one! Once it's ready, you can buy chicks from Marnie.

—Robin
stardewcraft.mail.robinWell: Robin here!^I know there's a lot of stone scattered around your farm.^If you have a surplus, you might consider having me build a well for you.^Wells can be placed all over your farm, and serve as convenient places to refill your watering can.^^Just swing by my shop with 75 stones and 1000g when you're ready for it.^-Robin[#]Build A Well
stardewcraft.mail.skullCave: I see you've entered the Skull Cavern. Well done.^I've got a better challenge for you, kid. Make it at least 25 levels deep. I've got a mountain of $ to send if you can do it.^  Your friend, Mr. Qi %item quest 20 %%[#]Qi's Challenge
stardewcraft.mail.spring_12: Dear @,^Tomorrow we're holding the Egg Festival in the town square. ^^You should arrive between 9 AM and 2 PM if you'd like to attend.^You wouldn't want to miss the annual egg hunt!^  -Mayor Lewis[#]Egg Festival Notice
stardewcraft.mail.spring_15_1: Hello, dear...^^I know you're just getting started as a gardener, so I wanted to give you a little tip.^^Most crops only grow in one season. When summer arrives, your spring crops will all die out. So plan ahead!^^-Granny Evelyn[#]Evelyn's Tip
stardewcraft.mail.spring_1_2: Notice:^^The price of raw materials at Robin's shop and Clint's shop has increased.[#]Raw Material Price Notice
stardewcraft.mail.spring_1_3:
Dear @,

The third spring is here!

Your grandfather's spirit will visit this spring to inspect the farm.

Prepare well and make him proud of what you've achieved!

—An old friend
stardewcraft.mail.spring_20_1:
Dear @,

I noticed you haven't upgraded any tools yet. If you have enough ore and gold, bring them to the blacksmith shop.

I can make your tools stronger and more durable.

—Clint
stardewcraft.mail.spring_23: Dear @,^Tomorrow we're all getting together for the Flower Dance.^^If you can find a partner, you might even want to participate in the dance yourself!^There's a little clearing beyond the forest west of town where we hold the dance. Arrive between 9 AM and 2 PM if you're interested.^  -Mayor Lewis[#]Flower Dance Notice
stardewcraft.mail.spring_25_1:
@,

You've been on the farm almost a month. Have you noticed the special things you can forage in spring?

Daffodils, dandelions, leeks... they're good stuff!

—Linus
stardewcraft.mail.spring_2_1: Hello there,^Just got back from a fishing trip. You should come down to the beach some time.^I've got something for ya.^-Willy %item quest 13 true %%[#]Willy's Invitation
stardewcraft.mail.spring_5_1:
Hi @!

I'm Caroline, Pierre's wife. Your garden is looking good! Don't forget to water it, or your crops will wither.

Keep it up!
—Caroline
stardewcraft.mail.spring_8_1:
Hi @,

I've had so much carpentry work lately that my wood supply is running low.

Could you bring me 50 pieces of wood? I'll make it worth your while!

—Robin
stardewcraft.mail.summer_1:
Hey @,

Summer is here! Clear out your spring crops and plant summer seeds.

I have blueberry, melon, and tomato seeds for sale. Come take a look!
—Pierre
stardewcraft.mail.summer_10: Dear @,^Tomorrow we're all gathering at the beach for the annual Pelican Town Luau.^^The highlight of the event is the communal potluck. Make sure you bring something good to contribute!^The governor himself is attending the event, so make sure you're on your best behavior.^Come to the beach sometime between 9 AM and 2 PM.^   -Mayor Lewis[#]Luau Notice
stardewcraft.mail.summer_13_1:
Dear @,

I've noticed how hard you've been working. Here's a little spending money from the city.

Remember to eat well!

Love,
—Mom
stardewcraft.mail.summer_19_1:
@,

Have you reached the bottom of the mines? They say there are many valuable ores down there.

Watch out for the monsters. They won't go easy on you.

—Clint
stardewcraft.mail.summer_1_2:
@,

Another summer is here.

Have you considered valuable long-term crops? Starfruit is expensive, but very profitable.

—Pierre
stardewcraft.mail.summer_20_1: @-^I'm gathering data on the correlation between soil alkalinity and crop fructose levels. Long story short, I need a fresh melon from your farm. If you brought me one I'd be very grateful.^   -Demetrius%item quest 104 %%[#]Demetrius Asks For A Sample
stardewcraft.mail.summer_22_1:
Hey @,

The saloon is out of tomatoes and I need a fresh one for tonight's special.

If you're growing tomatoes, bring me one and I'll buy you a drink!

—Gus
stardewcraft.mail.summer_27:
Dear residents,

The Dance of the Moonlight Jellies is tomorrow!

Come to the beach at 10 PM to watch their annual migration.

It's one of Stardew Valley's most beautiful sights!

—Mayor Lewis
stardewcraft.mail.summer_28: Dear @,^Tonight at around 10 o'clock PM, a rare and beautiful event will take place.^^The moonlight jellies will be passing by Pelican Town on their long journey south for the winter.^^We're all gathering at the beach to watch. You don't want to miss this!^See you tonight,^ -Demetrius[#]Dance Of The Moonlight Jellies
stardewcraft.mail.summer_3_1: @-^This is embarrassing... I lost my lucky purple shorts. I'm telling you because I think I can trust you.^If you find them, bring them back to me DISCREETLY. I'll pay well.^Thanks.^   -Mayor Lewis%item quest 102 %%[#]Lewis Asks For A Favor
stardewcraft.mail.summer_6_1:
Hi @,

If your crops aren't doing well, try fertilizer.

My basic fertilizer can improve crop quality.

—Pierre
stardewcraft.mail.summer_8_1:
Hey @,

Several ranch fences have broken. I need 40 stones for repairs.

Could you collect some? I'll pay you!

—Marnie
stardewcraft.mail.winter_1:
Hi @,

Winter is here, but don't be discouraged!

Most crops won't grow, but it's a great time to fish, upgrade your tools, and explore the mines.

—Mayor Lewis
stardewcraft.mail.winter_10_1:
@,

Ghosts have appeared in the deeper mines and are threatening miners. The Adventurer's Guild needs your help.

Slay 5 ghosts and you'll be well rewarded!

—Marlon
stardewcraft.mail.winter_12_1: @-^I am researching the forgotten art of shadow divination. I require an item known as 'Void Essence'. Bring it to me and you will be rewarded.^ -M. Rasmodius, Wizard %item quest 111 %%[#]Wizard's Request
stardewcraft.mail.winter_14_1:
Hey @,

You can fish in winter, too! Winter fish are completely different from those in other seasons.

Visit my shop. I have new bait for sale.

—Willy
stardewcraft.mail.winter_17:
Dear residents,

The Night Market begins tomorrow and lasts for three days, Winter 17–19!

Visit the beach from 5 PM until 2 AM for rare goods and food!

—Mayor Lewis
stardewcraft.mail.winter_18: Dear @,^I would like to give you some information about an upcoming event: the Feast of the Winter Star. It's a time for the community to come together and think back on all the good fortune we've had this year.^A favorite tradition is the "secret gift exchange", where everyone in town is randomly assigned to someone else. On the day of the festival, everyone brings a gift for their secret friend and surprises them with something special!^This year, your secret friend is:^    %secretsanta ^Don't tell anyone! The feast will take place on the 25th from 9AM to 2PM at the town square. See you then! ^   -Mayor Lewis[#]Secret Gift-Giver
stardewcraft.mail.winter_1_2:
Dear @,

It's the second winter.

If you don't have a greenhouse yet, complete the Community Center collections to restore it.

A greenhouse lets you grow crops all year!

—Mayor Lewis
stardewcraft.mail.winter_24: Dear @,^Tomorrow is the Feast of the Winter Star.^Did you get a gift for your 'secret friend'... %secretsanta?^The feast starts at 9 AM in the town square. See you then! ^   -Mayor Lewis[#]Feast Of The Winter Star Reminder
stardewcraft.mail.winter_27_1:
Dear @,

Another new year is almost here!

Looking back at everything you've accomplished on the farm this year, you've done wonderfully.

Here's to an even better year ahead!

—Mayor Lewis
stardewcraft.mail.winter_2_1: Hey, I've got a little challenge for you:^    Catch me a squid.^You can fish them from the ocean at night. They only show up in the winter, though.^   -Willy%item quest 109 %%[#]Willy's Challenge
stardewcraft.mail.winter_7: Dear @,^Tomorrow we're all gathering in front of Marnie's house for the Festival of Ice.^^It's a celebration of winter... there'll be snowmen, ice sculptures, and an ice fishing competition!^Arrive between 9 AM and 2 PM if you'd like to participate.^  -Mayor Lewis[#]Festival Of Ice Notice
stardewcraft.quest.1.description: You received a letter from the local wizard. He claims to have information regarding the old community center.
stardewcraft.quest.1.title: Meet The Wizard
stardewcraft.quest.102.description: Mayor Lewis has lost his purple "shorts". He's asking you to find and return them... Discreetly.
stardewcraft.quest.102.objective: Find and return Mayor Lewis' purple shorts.
stardewcraft.quest.102.target_message: You found them... where? ...Oh!...Uhmm...Heh.#$b#There? I have no idea how they could've gotten there...*cough*#$b#This stays between you and me. Got it?$u
stardewcraft.quest.102.title: Mayor's "Shorts"
stardewcraft.quest.11.description: If you're going to keep mining, you should build a furnace.
stardewcraft.quest.11.title: Forging Ahead
stardewcraft.quest.12.description: Now that you've built a furnace, you can smelt some metal. According to Clint's instructions, if you place 5 copper ore and 1 piece of coal in the furnace, it should produce a copper bar.
stardewcraft.quest.12.objective: Use your furnace to smelt a Copper Bar.
stardewcraft.quest.12.title: Smelting
stardewcraft.quest.13.description: Someone named Willy invited you to visit the beach south of town. He says he has something to give you.
stardewcraft.quest.13.objective: Visit the beach south of town before 5:00pm.
stardewcraft.quest.13.title: To The Beach
stardewcraft.quest.14.description: There's an old mine shaft in the mountains north of town. There could be valuable minerals inside, but Marlon hinted that it might be dangerous.
stardewcraft.quest.14.title: Explore The Mine
stardewcraft.quest.15.description: If you can slay 10 slimes, you'll have earned your place in the Adventurer's Guild.
stardewcraft.quest.15.title: Initiation
stardewcraft.quest.16.description: You successfully dispatched 10 slimes. Now you can enter the Adventurer's Guild.
stardewcraft.quest.16.title: Initiation
stardewcraft.quest.17.description: It seems that the mine elevator is still functional. It will allow you to quickly return to any elevator doors you've discovered. A deeper expedition might be in order.
stardewcraft.quest.17.title: Deeper In The Mine
stardewcraft.quest.18.description: So far, there's no sign of the bottom. How low does it go?
stardewcraft.quest.18.objective: Reach the bottom of the mine.
stardewcraft.quest.18.title: To The Bottom?
stardewcraft.quest.19.description: You found a strange looking key in the bottom of the mines.
stardewcraft.quest.19.objective: Discover the purpose of the Skull Key.
stardewcraft.quest.19.title: The Skull Key
stardewcraft.quest.20.description: You've been challenged to reach level 25 in the skull cavern. You've been promised a substantial reward if you're successful.
stardewcraft.quest.20.objective: Reach level 25 in the Skull Cavern.
stardewcraft.quest.20.title: Qi's Challenge
stardewcraft.quest.21.description: Marnie came by the farm and asked if you'd bring her a cave carrot. She's trying to train her goats to speak, and cave carrot is their favorite snack.
stardewcraft.quest.21.objective: Bring a Cave Carrot into Marnie's shop.
stardewcraft.quest.21.title: Marnie's Request
stardewcraft.quest.22.description: Jodi swung by the farm to ask you to dinner at 7:00 PM. Her only request was that you bring a largemouth bass for her fish casserole.
stardewcraft.quest.22.objective: Enter Jodi's house with a largemouth bass at 7:00 PM.
stardewcraft.quest.22.title: Fish Casserole
stardewcraft.quest.23.description: You found an ancient-looking object. Could it be some kind of artifact from long ago? Perhaps Gunther, curator of the local museum, has the answer.
stardewcraft.quest.23.title: Archaeology
stardewcraft.quest.24.description: Gunther asked if you'd consider donating any new artifacts or minerals you find to the museum. He says he'll compensate you by way of occasional rare goods.
stardewcraft.quest.24.objective: Donate an artifact or a mineral to the museum.
stardewcraft.quest.24.title: Archaeology
stardewcraft.quest.25.description: Giving gifts is a great way to build friendships. Learn each person's individual tastes and you'll be popular in no time.
stardewcraft.quest.25.title: How To Win Friends
stardewcraft.quest.26.description: There's something odd going on in the Community Center...
stardewcraft.quest.26.title: "Rat Problem"
stardewcraft.quest.6.description: If you want to become a farmer, you have to start with the basics. Use your hoe to till the soil, then use a seed packet on the tilled soil to sow a crop. Water every day until the crop is ready for harvest.
stardewcraft.quest.6.title: Getting Started
stardewcraft.quest.7.description: Robin, the local carpenter, lives north of town. In exchange for raw materials and money, she'll construct new buildings on your farm. You'll need her to build a coop or barn so that you can raise animals.
stardewcraft.quest.7.title: Raising Animals
stardewcraft.quest.8.description: As you gain experience, you'll discover new crafting recipes to increase profit and make life easier. A scarecrow, for example, will prevent crows from snacking on your precious crops.
stardewcraft.quest.8.objective: Reach Farming level 1 and craft a scarecrow.
stardewcraft.quest.8.title: Advancement
stardewcraft.quest.9.description: It would be a nice gesture to introduce yourself around town. Some people might be anxious to meet the new farmer.
stardewcraft.quest.9.title: Introductions

stardewcraft.lost_book.found: You found a lost book. The library has been expanded.
stardewcraft.lost_book.text.0:
Tips On Farming--
*Use fertilizer to improve quality, reduce workload, or hasten crop growth.
*Fruit trees take a whole season to grow, but they require very little maintenance. Keep the area directly around your new sapling clear, or else it may not grow properly.
*Crops will die as soon as the season ends, unless they grow in multiple seasons (e.g. Corn).
*Some crops, such as kale and wheat, need to be harvested with the scythe.
stardewcraft.lost_book.text.1:
...This is a book by Marnie.
 'Animals are very sensitive. They like to be pet every day, and prefer to eat grass outdoors than dry hay. They don't like being outside in the rain, though. Happy animals produce higher quality products!'
stardewcraft.lost_book.text.2:
On Foraging
 The local woods and mountains are great places to find wild produce! A good forager will clear out any weeds, stumps, or stones from these areas, so the wild produce has plenty of space to grow!
Expert foragers know the secret to cultivating wild food so that it can be grown on the farm. Isn't that amazing?
stardewcraft.lost_book.text.3:
The Fisherman, Act I:
Tex: Gordy, how do you catch so many fish? For me, it takes forever!
Gordy: You must make the choice to become a true fisherman... and over time your fishing speed will increase!
Tex: So you're saying that improving my fishing skill will make me fish faster?
Gordy: Correct. One day you may even learn the secret to creating your very own bobbers, improving your mastery even more. Now, begone!
stardewcraft.lost_book.text.4:
How deep do the mines go?
 This question has been pondered by many Stardew Valley explorers over the years... The truth is, no one really knows. Or at least, they aren't telling anyone.
Unfortunately, many of those who venture deep into the mines never return...
However, there have been a few bold adventurers who have traveled deep into the mines, and have resurfaced with interesting reports.
 Apparently, there are three distinct areas in the mine, each with unique monsters and treasures.
Some adventurers speak of gigantic underground lakes and strange creatures... But none of these claims have been proven.
stardewcraft.lost_book.text.5:
An old farmer's journal:
 I've been here for a year now, and I've started to make friends with the local townspeople. It sure feels great! And they're sending me gifts and secret family recipes in the mail, too! That's really helpful.
stardewcraft.lost_book.text.6:
'Scarecrows'
 Once you start growing a lot of crops on your farm, you can expect to be visited by crows. In the morning, you might discover that a crow has made breakfast out of your hard work!
One way to prevent those bothersome crows from eating your crops is to set up scarecrows near your crops.
Be aware that scarecrows have limited range, so you'll need multiple if your farm is large.
Scarecrows keep track of how many crows they've diverted. You can use that to tell if they're in a useful spot.

* 'Collectible Scarecrows' aren't just for looks! They work just the same as the regular model.
stardewcraft.lost_book.text.7:
The Secret of the Stardrop
--
For thousands of years, people have been intrigued by the mysterious powers of the stardrop... but no one knows where they come from!
 Professor R. J. Kutler, a leading researcher on strange fruit, says this: 'We've discovered traces of genetic material on meteorites that closely resemble the Stardrop, but it's not a proven match'.
Regardless of where they come from, the peculiar fruit is said to be uncommonly delicious... and some even claim they grant special power to those who eat them.
stardewcraft.lost_book.text.8:
Journey Of The Prairie King -- The Smash Hit Video Game!

Did you know? Anyone who beats 'Journey Of The Prairie King' is automatically entered into a drawing for a special prize!

Did you know? The developer has stated that the protagonist is based on a real-life character... A true cowboy hero from a prairie-island in the Gem Sea!
stardewcraft.lost_book.text.9:
-- A Study On Diamond Yields --

 After years of research in the mines, I believe I've learned something about diamond frequency.
My research involved only the stones that are scattered about the mines...The ones that are broken with a pickaxe. Mineral yields from other sources require more research.
Diamonds seem to only form at mine level 50 or greater. At level 50, approximately 1 in 500 stones will be diamond-rich.
 After level 50, the frequency of diamond formation seems to increase by about .000016 per level. Quite a rare gem!
-M. Jasper
stardewcraft.lost_book.text.10:
-~-Brewmaster's Guide-~-
   Ah... to brew!
The rich smell of yeast wafting through a cedar loft... The floral overtones of freshly cut hops on a winter's eve... but I digress. You are probably more interested in the practical side of brewing...
To brew, you will need a keg. I'll leave it up to you to devise blueprints for a keg.
Kegs can be used to make several kinds of product. If vegetables are placed inside, the keg will produce juice. Juice takes the least amount of time to brew.
If wheat is placed in the keg, it will produce beer. Beer takes a while to brew, but it is quite profitable.
Placing hops in a keg will produce the beloved 'Pale Ale'
Place fruit in the keg to make wine. Wine takes the longest of all to make, but a wine made from the finest fruit is worth quite a bit!
Be patient with your keg... you'll know it's finished when it's perfectly still. And only drink in moderation, or you'll surely regret it!
stardewcraft.lost_book.text.11:
Mysteries Of The Dwarves
The Dwarves call themselves 'Smoluanu'... which translates to 'sky people'. An odd name for a group that lives deep underground, isn't it?
Another mystery of the dwarves is the advanced technology they supposedly possess. Evidence such as this had led me, despite the ridicule of my colleagues, to propose a new theory:
I believe the dwarves are the remnants of a once advanced civilization whose interplanetary vehicle crashed on this planet long ago.
I propose that this dwarvish spaceship bore down, deep underground... and over time, the dwarves became adapted to their new underground environment.
 My colleagues ask, 'Why didn't they come above ground and live on the surface?' ...Perhaps their old planet had a thicker atmosphere that protected them from stellar radiation, and they simply could not survive in our sunlight.
 That would explain why they only surface at night to take what they need from our houses...

-M. Jasper
stardewcraft.lost_book.text.12:
Highlights From The Book Of Yoba

Before time there was only the endless golden light.
 The light called out to itself...'Yoba'.
Yoba wanted more.
Yoba swirled the golden light into a vortex. Yoba swirled and swirled until a hole formed in the eye of the vortex.
From this hole sprung a seed.
Yoba smoothed the golden light.
Yoba smoothed and smoothed, and the light became soil.
Into this soil, Yoba planted the seed.
The seed sprouted, and behold! A vine sprung skyward, twisting and probing, casting a writhing shadow onto the golden void.
After 11 days, the vine bore fruit.
Yoba, with knowing wisdom, peeled the tough skin off the fruit and saw that the world was inside.
And so that is how the world came to be.
stardewcraft.lost_book.text.13:
Marriage Guide For Farmers
Before you ask someone to marry you, you'll have to date them for a while first (Ask someone to date you with a bouquet from Pierre's).
 When you're ready to pop the big question, you'll need to give them a 'Mermaid's Pendant'. Everyone knows what it means when you present them with one of those.
 It's rumored that on stormy days, the ghost of an old mariner appears in Stardew Valley, clutching just such a pendant.
 After the wedding ceremony, your partner will move in with you. Remember to treat your spouse well... They still like gifts even after marriage!

(Paid for by Pierre)
stardewcraft.lost_book.text.14:
The Fisherman, Act II:
Tex: Gordy, tell me your best fisherman's story.
Gordy: *deep sigh*...I've caught a lot of big fish in my time...And some that are very rare and difficult...But there was one that I struggled to catch for three days and three nights
Gordy: I call this fish... 'The Legend'. He was a huge beast... And the harder I tugged on the line, the harder he tugged back. I let my guard down for a moment and he snapped my boat in two. I've never fished since.
Tex: Do you think anyone will ever catch him?
Gordy: Hmm... If this person were a master at fishing, and caught all other rare fish first, and made sure they ate the correct kind of food... then maybe. Above all you've got to have respect for the water, son.
Tex:...son? Do you mean... you're...
 ...f...father?
Gordy: Yes, my boy.

**Dramatic Music as the curtains fall**
stardewcraft.lost_book.text.15:
Technology Report!

The blueprints for an advanced piece of machinery called a 'Crystalarium' have recently been published.
 This machine can grow crystals from almost nothing, providing their owners with endless supplies of valuable gems!
Here's how it works: Place a gem of your choice inside the crystalarium...
now be patient, it can take up to several days... but eventually the crystalarium will grow a copy of whatever you placed inside!
You'll know it's ready when it stops wiggling. Once you remove your gem the crystalarium will start working on yet another clone... You'll never need to restock it unless you want to change the kind of gem it produces!
Unfortunately, the crystalarium doesn't work with the extremely rare gemstone known as 'Prismatic Shard'... For some reason, the EMF from the shard interacts negatively with the crystalarium.
stardewcraft.lost_book.text.16:
Secrets Of The Legendary Fish

Fishermen speak of five rare and unique fish that can only be caught by skilled anglers. Once caught, they will never appear again.

The crimsonfish lives in the warm ocean waters of summer. It's been sighted on the far eastern side of the beach.

The Glacierfish, which only appears in winter, can be caught off the southern tip of arrowhead island in Cindersap Forest... near where the river meets the ocean.

The Anglerfish has been spotted in fall, north of town where the river flows down from the mountains.

There's rumor of a strange, twisted fish that lives in the sewer.



The final fish, of a species never before caught, is known simply as 'legend'. It is rumored that he lives in a log submerged in the mountain lake, and only ventures out on rainy spring days to nibble at the frog's eggs. Only the most skilled fisherman can hope to catch this one.

Train at fishing and be persistent, and eventually you will catch these elusive fish. Make sure to respect the water and don't remove too many fish from the ecosystem.
stardewcraft.lost_book.text.17:
...Saw something weird in the tunnel leading out from Pelican Town. There's a little door hidden in the dark. Couldn't get it open, though.

-Gunther
stardewcraft.lost_book.text.18: Note From Gunther: Wow, this library has really become great, thanks to your help! Thanks a bunch!
stardewcraft.lost_book.text.19: Goblins^by M. Jasper^^The species commonly known as "Goblin" seems to have originated in the forests of the far northeast, beyond the Bluemire Hills. Characterized by their green skin, bright red eyes, and foul smell, initial encounters with Goblins can be frightening for unexperienced travelers.^^Despite their unsettling appearance, Goblins possess an intellectual and emotional capacity akin to humans, and have no trouble learning our customs and languages. The goblins I've met have been rather friendly and amiable, once I've shown that I mean no harm. Unfortunately, centuries of distrust and ill-treatment from humans has led many Goblins to pursue careers in the employ of witches, warlocks, necromancers, and other unsavory types.^^A traditional Goblin diet largely consists of grub meat, typically from the large and juicy grub varieties native to the Goblin home-forest. On special occasions, Goblins will indulge in an item called 'void mayonnaise'... considered perhaps the finest delicacy in all Goblin cuisine.

stardewcraft.casino.calico_jack.rules_1: The objective is to get as close to 21 as possible. Cards range from 1 to 9, except for the first card which can be as high as 11. Each player starts with two cards, but the dealer's first card remains hidden. Each turn you can choose to draw a random number between 1 and 9 or pass.
stardewcraft.casino.calico_jack.rules_2: Once you pass, the dealer's hidden card is revealed. She must draw until her total reaches or exceeds 18. If either player exceeds 21 on their turn, they lose. If the dealer passes, then all cards are revealed and the highest score wins.

stardewcraft.quest.111.title: A Dark Reagent
stardewcraft.quest.111.description: The wizard wants you to descend into the mines and fetch him a Void Essence. He needs it for some kind of dark magic.
stardewcraft.quest.111.target_message: Ah, you've brought it. You've earned my gratitude, and a 1000g reward. Now go.
stardewcraft.quest.112.title: A Favor For Clint
stardewcraft.quest.112.description: Clint got a new hammer and he wants to test it out on a variety of metals.
stardewcraft.quest.112.target_message: Hey, it's the iron bar I asked for. It looks strong... perfect.#$b#Thanks, @. I appreciate this.
stardewcraft.mail.winter_6_1: I've got an unusual request. Could you keep this a secret?^ I want you to deliver an amethyst to Emily. It's her favorite stone. Tell her it's from me.^   -Clint %item quest 110 %%[#]Clint's Unusual Request
stardewcraft.mail.winter_17_1: @,^Sorry to bother you again, but I need another favor.^I got a new hammer and I want to try it on a variety of metals.^Could you smelt an iron bar and bring it to me? ^Thanks.^ -Clint %item quest 112 %%[#]Clint's Request
stardewcraft.quest.113.title: Robin's Request
stardewcraft.quest.113.description: Robin wrote to you asking for some hardwood.
stardewcraft.quest.113.target_message: Oh, you brought it! I know I can always count on you, @.$h#$b#Mmhmm... This wood is perfect. It's exactly what I need. Thanks!
stardewcraft.quest.114.title: Fish Stew
stardewcraft.quest.114.description: Gus wants to make fish stew, but he needs an albacore.
stardewcraft.quest.114.target_message: *sniff*...*sniff*... What's that? Something smells like albacore!#$b#Aha! You brought it! Thanks a million!
stardewcraft.quest.115.title: Fresh Fruit
stardewcraft.quest.115.description: Emily wants a taste of spring. She's asking for a fresh apricot.
stardewcraft.quest.115.target_message: Oh... You followed through! Thanks, this looks delicious!$h
stardewcraft.quest.116.title: Granny's Gift
stardewcraft.quest.116.description: Evelyn wants to surprise her husband with a gift.
stardewcraft.quest.116.target_message: Oh, thank you, dear. This leek looks delicious. George will be so happy.#$b#He loves when I make eggs with leeks for breakfast.
stardewcraft.quest.117.title: Pierre's Notice
stardewcraft.quest.117.description: Pierre will pay "top coin" to whoever brings him a plate of sashimi. Apparently he's really craving the stuff.
stardewcraft.quest.117.target_message: It's about time! I was starting to get the shakes, I wanted this fish so bad. *munch*... Mmm, now that's good.#$b#Thanks, @.$h
stardewcraft.mail.winter_21_1: @-^How are you doing? Hope the winter hasn't been too hard on you.^Anyway, I'm writing to ask you for some hardwood. I need about ten pieces, if you've got it.^If not, no worries. Take Care!^  -Robin%item quest 113 %%[#]Robin's Request
stardewcraft.mail.winter_26_1: Dear @-^I want to make fish stew, but I need an albacore! I know they're almost out of season... sorry about the short notice. Could you catch one for me?^   -Gus%item quest 114 %%[#]Gus Needs A Certain Fish
stardewcraft.mail.spring_6_2: @-^I'm really craving a fresh apricot. I haven't been able to find one at the store, so I'm asking you. I'll pay you well for it!^   -Emily%item quest 115 %%[#]Emily's Request
stardewcraft.mail.spring_15_2: Dear @,^I'd like to surprise my husband with a gift. He's a big fan of leeks. Could you bring me one?^   -Granny Evelyn%item quest 116 %%[#]Evelyn's Surprise
stardewcraft.mail.spring_21_2: NOTICE^Pierre here... I really, really want a plate of sashimi. I'll pay top coin to whoever brings me some.^   -Pierre%item quest 117 %%[#]Pierre's Craving
stardewcraft.quest.118.title: Aquatic Research
stardewcraft.quest.118.description: Demetrius is studying the toxin levels of the local pufferfish. He'd like you to bring him one.
stardewcraft.quest.118.target_message: There you are. The specimen looks perfect. I'm going to get it on ice straight away. Thanks, @!
stardewcraft.quest.119.title: A Soldier's Star
stardewcraft.quest.119.description: Kent wants to give his wife a starfruit for their anniversary.
stardewcraft.quest.119.target_message: Hey. Shhh... Don't let Jodi see.#$b#Ah, this looks juicy. She'll love it. Thank you so much.$h
stardewcraft.quest.120.title: Mayor's Need
stardewcraft.quest.120.description: Mayor Lewis wants truffle oil. He won't explain what it's for. Maybe it's none of your business.
stardewcraft.quest.120.objective: Bring Lewis a bottle of Truffle Oil.
stardewcraft.quest.120.target_message: You got the oil? Let me see...#$b#It's high quality... very slick. Great. Thank you.
stardewcraft.quest.121.title: Wanted: Lobster
stardewcraft.quest.121.description: Gus put out a notice requesting a fresh lobster.
stardewcraft.quest.121.target_message: Something smells like fresh lobster. Oh, that's good.$h#$b#Take care, friend.
stardewcraft.quest.122.title: Pam Needs Juice
stardewcraft.quest.122.description: Pam's TV Remote is dead. She's having a tough time going back and forth between the couch and the TV dial.
stardewcraft.quest.122.target_message: Hey, you pulled through with the battery pack! Thanks, kid... You're a life-saver!$h
stardewcraft.mail.summer_6_2: Fisherman Wanted^I need a good pufferfish specimen. I'm conducting an experiment on the toxin created by the pufferfish.^Reward: 1000g^ -Demetrius%item quest 118 %%[#]Demetrius' Study On Toxins
stardewcraft.mail.summer_15_2: Dear Farmer @,^I'd like to give my wife a starfruit for our anniversary. Are you growing any on your farm? If you brought me one, I'd be very grateful.^   -Kent%item quest 119 %%[#]Kent Needs A Gift
stardewcraft.mail.summer_21_2: @,^I need truffle oil. Don't ask me why.^ -Mayor Lewis%item quest 120 %%[#]Lewis' Request
stardewcraft.mail.fall_6_2: Wanted: 1 Fresh Lobster for a marvelous bisque I'm creating.^Who: Gus, proprietor of the Stardrop Saloon^Reward: 800g %item quest 121 %%[#]Gus Needs Lobster
stardewcraft.mail.fall_19_2: NOTICE^Does anybody have one of them battery packs? My TV remote died, and it's a real hassle getting off the couch to change the station.^  -Pam%item quest 122 %%[#]Pam Needs Help
stardewcraft.quest.123.title: Staff Of Power
stardewcraft.quest.123.description: The Wizard is creating a staff of phenomenal power. Who knows what it's for. He needs an iridium bar to finish it.
stardewcraft.quest.123.target_message: Ah, precious iridium. You've done well, @. You have my gratitude. Now, leave.
stardewcraft.quest.124.title: Catch a Lingcod
stardewcraft.quest.124.description: Willy is challenging you to catch a Lingcod.
stardewcraft.quest.124.target_message: Hey, that's a real lunker! You've certainly got the angler's blood in you.$h
stardewcraft.quest.125.title: Exotic Spirits
stardewcraft.quest.125.description: Gus wants to make a Coco-no-no, but he's missing the main ingredient.
stardewcraft.quest.125.target_message: Coconut! Now there's a soothing sight for my winter eyes.$h#$b#It's going to be perfect for my coco-no-no. Thanks!
stardewcraft.mail.winter_5_2: @,^I'm creating an enchanted staff of phenomenal power.^However, I'm missing something: an Iridium Bar.^I'm willing to pay 5x the market value for it. Bring it as soon as you can.^ -M. Rasmodius, Wizard %item quest 123 %%[#]Wizard Needs A Rare Item
stardewcraft.mail.winter_13_2: I've got another challenge for you: Catch me a Lingcod.^They don't go down easy, but I know you can do it.^  -Willy%item quest 124 %%[#]Willy's Challenge #2
stardewcraft.mail.winter_19_2: Dear @,^I'm at my wit's end. I desperately want to make a Coco-no-no at the saloon, but I have no way of getting a coconut!^Can you help me?^  -Gus%item quest 125 %%[#]Gus Needs A Coconut
stardewcraft.mail.friendship_gift.caroli: Dear @,^Here's a vegetable from the little garden I keep out back. You probably have more veggies than you know what to do with, but oh well.   ^   -Caroline%item id (O)190 1 (O)192 1 (O)24 1 %%[#]A Gift From Caroline
stardewcraft.mail.friendship_gift.lewis: @,^I'm really glad you've become part of our community! I've enclosed a 500g check from the Stardew Valley Agricultural Fund to help you continue your good work. ^Maybe you can buy some more seeds with it.  ^  Sincerely, Mr. Lewis%item money 500 501 %%[#]A Gift From Lewis
stardewcraft.mail.friendship_gift.clint: Um, Hello...     ^Sorry, I'm not good at writing letters. I made one metal bar too many, and I thought you might need it.  ^   -Clint, the blacksmith %item id (O)334 1 (O)335 1 (O)336 1 %%[#]A Gift From Clint
stardewcraft.mail.friendship_gift.demetr: Dear @,^I was conducting a field study the other day, and I found this specimen. ^I hope you find it as interesting as I did.    ^   -Demetrius%item id (O)392 1 (O)394 1 (O)132 1 (O)66 1 %%[#]A Gift From Demetrius
stardewcraft.mail.friendship_gift.evelyn: Hello there, dear,  I hope your farm is doing well.^ I'm sending you a little something from my kitchen... I hope it didn't crumble in the mail.  ^   -Evelyn  %item id (O)216 1 (O)220 1 (O)223 1 %%[#]A Gift From Evelyn
stardewcraft.mail.friendship_gift.emily: Hi!^How are you doing? I hope you enjoy the gift I've sent you... Well, goodbye! +   ^   -Emily %item id (O)397 1 (O)428 1 (O)440 1 %%[#]A Gift From Emily
stardewcraft.mail.friendship_gift.george: Found some good quality stone. ^Maybe you can build with it or something.  ^   -George %item id (O)390 35 %%[#]A Gift From George
stardewcraft.mail.friendship_gift.gus: @!^I made you a little treat this morning in the saloon. Dig in!   ^   -Your friend, Gus%item id (O)224 1 (O)213 1 (O)211 1 (O)207 1 (O)200 1 (O)195 1 (O)198 1 %%[#]A Gift From Gus
stardewcraft.mail.friendship_gift.jodi: Dear @,^I ordered too much fertilizer for the garden!! I bet you can put it to some good use. Take care!  ^   -Jodi %item id (O)368 5 (O)369 5 (O)370 5 %%[#]A Gift From Jodi
stardewcraft.mail.friendship_gift.linus: Hello, friend.^The mountain lake has been kind to me lately. I'd like to share my good fortune with you.  ^   -Linus %item id (O)136 1 (O)143 1 (O)202 1 (O)227 1 (O)228 1 %%[#]A Gift From Linus
stardewcraft.mail.friendship_gift.marnie: Dear @,^You're such a good neighbor I thought I'd send over some animal feed to make your job easier. Keep it up! ^   -Marnie %item id (O)178 30 %%[#]A Gift From Marnie
stardewcraft.mail.friendship_gift.pam: Hey. ^I found this in a drawer somewhere. Thought you could use it.   ^   -Pam %item id (O)346 1 (O)349 1 (O)787 1 %%[#]A Gift From Pam
stardewcraft.mail.friendship_gift.pierre: Dear valued customer,^Thanks for visiting 'Pierre's'! Enclosed is your 'Cash-back Rewards Program' rebate. See you soon! ^   -Pierre^  P.S. Sorry for the stock message, @. Enjoy! %item money 250 601  %%[#]A Gift From Pierre
stardewcraft.mail.friendship_gift.robin: Hey there!^I had some extra wood lying around... I thought maybe you could use it. Take care!  ^   -Robin %item id (O)388 50 %%[#]A Gift From Robin
stardewcraft.mail.friendship_gift.shane: Hey,^I thought it would be fun to send you a letter. I don't really know what to write, though.^ Here, I've enclosed a treat for you. Don't tell anyone, but I snagged this from the back room of JojaMart ages ago.^Okay, see you soon. ^   -Shane %item id (O)215 1 (O)206 1 %%[#]A Gift From Shane
stardewcraft.mail.friendship_gift.wizard: Greetings, young adept.^I have enclosed in this package an item of arcane significance. Use it wisely.   ^   -M. Rasmodius, Wizard%item id (O)422 1 (O)82 1 (O)84 1 (O)70 1 %%[#]A Gift From the Wizard
stardewcraft.mail.friendship_gift.sandy: Greetings from Calico Desert!^Come visit me soon, I'm really bored out here :(. I've included a gift from the desert. You can come and thank me in person!   ^   -Sandy %item id (O)88 1 (O)90 1 (O)218 1 %%[#]A Gift From Sandy
event.linus.502969.george_raccoons: Grr... sounds like those raccoons are back again. Filthy varmints...
event.linus.502969.george_request: Ah, you turned up at the right moment, son.^Ah, you turned up at the right moment, miss.#$b#Could you do an old man a favor? Could you go around the corner and scare off those raccoons for me? They've been causin' a real mess.#$b#Thanks. Make sure you give 'em a good scare so they never come back.
event.linus.502969.fresh_food: I find a lot of hot, fresh food in these cans... stuff that will go to waste if I don't take it.
event.linus.502969.promise: You can go on home. I promise I won't rummage in George's can anymore.#$b#You can tell him you scared off the raccoons for good.
event.linus.502969.gus_knows: I know what you were doing, Linus.$3
event.linus.502969.gus_offer: If you need food... just ask. I don't want anyone in Pelican Town to go hungry.
event.linus.502969.gus_food: Here. I've got a basket of zucchini fritters for you. Just make sure you dip them in my spicy marinara!$h#$b#Go on... take it.
event.linus.502969.question: Do you think there's something wrong with what I'm doing?
event.linus.502969.response.1: Disgusting to you, maybe. To me, it's a way of life. And I haven't gotten sick yet. I only eat things that look fresh.
event.linus.502969.choice.2: No. It's a shame for food to go to waste.
event.linus.502969.response.2: Thanks, @. I knew you were an open-minded person. I feel good about what I'm doing. I'm not harming anyone.$h
event.linus.502969.choice.3: Yes, it's illegal. That's George's private property.
event.linus.502969.response.3: I don't believe in 'private property'. Besides, what do you want me to do? I need this food to survive. Have a heart.$s
event.linus.502969.choice.4: No, but you should get a job and stop leeching off others.
event.linus.502969.response.4: **Sigh**...#$b#Not everyone's cut out for this world, @. You don't know what it's like to be me. I'm not harming anyone, I just want to live life in my own way. Is that so wrong?
event.linus.26.firepit: @! Come stand next to the firepit. It feels great.
event.linus.26.hoped_visit: I was hoping you'd come by sometime.
event.linus.26.apology: I wanted to say sorry for mistrusting you at first.$s#$b#Most people don't treat me well, so I've learned to be cautious.$s
event.linus.26.friend: But you've been uncommonly nice to me. You're a unique person.$h#$b#...And I consider you a good friend.
event.linus.26.come_inside: Hey, I want to show you something. Come inside.$h
event.linus.26.wild_bait: Ah... there we go. See this? It's a special kind of fish bait that I make.#$b#It's top quality stuff... I'd eat it myself!#$b#Here, I want you to have the recipe.
event.linus.371652.robin_lunch: Are you hungry? I could make you some lunch... How about some leftover cave carrot stew?
event.linus.371652.linus_foraging: That's very nice of you, but no thanks! I've had great luck foraging today.$h
event.linus.371652.robin_prompt: @? You look like you have something to say...
event.linus.371652.choice.well: I'm just pleased that Linus is doing well...
event.linus.371652.choice.farm: I'd like to invite Linus to live on the farm with me...
event.linus.371652.robin_house: That's really generous! What a great idea! I can build a real cozy house for you, Linus.$h
event.linus.371652.robin_house_details: You'll finally have running water, heat, a roof over your head... just like the rest of us! Isn't that wonderful, Linus?
event.linus.371652.linus_chosen: I appreciate the kindness... I really do...$s#$b#But... I've told you before... I choose to live this way...
event.linus.371652.linus_lifestyle: I like to be alone most of the time... I like the quiet sounds... moving with the rhythm of nature...#$b#It's a way of life that I'm comfortable with. I don't ever want to change that.
event.linus.371652.robin_understands: I guess I never thought about it that way...$5
event.linus.371652.linus_dont_help: @... I cherish our friendship very much. And I know you do, too.$h#$b#But... You don't need to try and 'help' me... I know best how to live my own life... okay?
event.linus.371652.linus_berries: ...can you smell that? It's the sweet aroma of ripe berries...$h
event.linus.371652.linus_well: Thanks, @. You had me worried, there... I thought you were going to ask me to move on to the farm with you! *wink*#$b#You know, I consider you my closest friend in the valley... you've never tried to 'fix' me... you respect my way of life, even if you don't understand it.$h#$b#I really appreciate that.
event.linus.371652.linus_berries_well: Ah... can you smell that? It's the sweet aroma of ripe berries...$h
event.george.18.struggle: Nnnnggghh....I just can't reach it!$u#$b#If only I could get up from this infernal chair...$s
event.george.18.accident: *sigh*...It happened 30 years ago.$s#$b#I was working in the coal mines. We were near the end of our shift, but there was one last seam that needed to be broken up.#$b#I went in there aiming to set off a stick of dynamite, but my foot slipped into a crack and I dropped it. The dynamite exploded on impact.
event.george.18.hospital: The next thing I remember, I was laying in the hospital... and they told me I'd never walk again.
event.george.18.spry: So there you have it. You probably figured I was just too old to walk.#$b#Well I'll have you know that I'd be spryer than a spring chicken if I hadn't been in that accident!
event.george.18.kindness: You've been very nice to me, young man. I appreciate that.^You've been really nice to me, miss. I appreciate it.#$b#When you're old, you start to forget that anyone cares about you.
event.evelyn.19.smell: Oh! @! You're wondering what that good smell is?#$b#Why, that's nice of you to say! I'm actually baking my famous cookies!$h
event.evelyn.19.try_one: Here, why don't you try one?
event.evelyn.19.question: Well, what do you think?
event.evelyn.19.choice.hockey_puck: It was like chewing on a hockey puck
event.evelyn.19.recipe_offer: I think I've come to know you well enough to give you my recipe. Just make sure to keep it a secret.$h
event.gus.96.earnings: *sigh*... I'm just looking over last month's earnings... and it's not looking very good, @.$s#$b#The worst thing... and I hate to say this because she's my friend... is Pam! She hasn't paid off her tab in weeks!$s#$b#...But I can't ask her to do it. I know she'll get defensive, and I don't want to hurt her feelings.$s
event.gus.96.pam_thirsty: Hiya!$h#$b#Gus... I'm awful thirsty, if you catch my drift.
event.gus.96.question: @, what's going on here?
event.gus.96.choice.pay_now: You need to pay your tab right now!
event.gus.96.choice.finances: The saloon isn't doing well, financially
event.gus.96.settle_tab: ....$u#$b#*sigh* ...Well, I guess I'd better pay off that tab, then.$s
event.gus.96.drink: Now, let's get you that drink, Pam.$h
event.gus.96.final: Thanks for your help, @. This cash is going to be a big help to the saloon.
stardewcraft.npc.schedule.gus.mon.000: I'm getting some supplies for the saloon. Pierre's got the good stuff.$h
stardewcraft.npc.schedule.gus.fall_4.000: Seeing the doctor makes me nervous... What if I only have a few years left? I'm not at peace with the world yet!
stardewcraft.npc.schedule.gus.fall_4.001: It's my liver, isn't it Doctor? I can see it on your face. *Sigh*... I really need to cut back on that sweet, delicious Stardew Valley wine.$s
stardewcraft.npc.schedule.gus.sun.000: Hey @. Sorry... the bar's closed until the game's over.
stardewcraft.npc.schedule.george.23.000: Hmmpph... The wife's making me go to the clinic today.
stardewcraft.npc.schedule.george.23.002: Well how much longer do I have, Doc?
stardewcraft.npc.schedule.george.winter_: I'm just here for the free coffee.
stardewcraft.npc.schedule.george.sun.000: I've never been religious but hey... I'm old.
stardewcraft.npc.schedule.george.sun.001: Hehehe... I skipped church to come here! I hope Yoba isn't too angry with me.$h
stardewcraft.npc.schedule.george.desert_: What is she mumbling about? I'm here for the spicy food tent!
stardewcraft.npc.schedule.evelyn.2.000: When you get to be my age you have to see the doctor more often.
stardewcraft.npc.schedule.evelyn.2.001: Oh dear, is it an emergency? Why are you here?$s
stardewcraft.npc.schedule.evelyn.23.000: Now now, dear... It's important that Doctor Harvey takes a good look at you. He's a nice young man! Behave yourself, for your dear old wife's sake.
stardewcraft.npc.schedule.evelyn.23.001: Could you check his lungs? He's been wheezing lately.
stardewcraft.npc.schedule.evelyn.winter_: This is one of the newer traditions in Pelican Town... but we've taken to it rather quickly. Haven't we, George?
stardewcraft.npc.schedule.linus.desert_f: I hitched a ride underneath the bus.#$e#You can't find this Calico Desert flavor anywhere else. Heheh...$h
stardewcraft.npc.schedule.linus.winter.0: Even someone like me needs to warm up indoors now and then.
stardewcraft.npc.rainy.abigail: The valley looks more interesting in the rain... don't you think?
stardewcraft.npc.rainy.robin: The rain doesn't stop me from getting a job done!$h#$e#Although soggy wood isn't a joy to work with.$s
stardewcraft.npc.rainy.demetrius: Greetings. Stay inside if you want to keep warm.
stardewcraft.npc.rainy.maru: When it rains I have a good excuse to work on my gadgets all day.$h#$e#It must be kind of boring for you, though.
stardewcraft.npc.rainy.sebastian: If you're lucky, you might see a frog in this weather.
stardewcraft.npc.rainy.linus: A warm rain is a pleasant way to get clean.$h
stardewcraft.npc.rainy.pierre: Most people stay indoors on days like this... It's not good for business.$s
stardewcraft.npc.rainy.caroline: My garden is happy today.$h#$e#...and our water bill will be lower this month.
stardewcraft.npc.rainy.alex: Hmmph. This is not good weather for sports.$s#$e#Oh well, I can always lift weights inside.$h
stardewcraft.npc.rainy.george: It's awful cold, isn't it? What a rotten day.
stardewcraft.npc.rainy.evelyn: When I woke up I heard dripping from somewhere... I think the roof might be leaking.$s#$e#In the old days, George would've scampered right up and fixed it... *sigh*$s
stardewcraft.npc.rainy.lewis: Hi there, @. Taking a break?#$e#I hope the river doesn't overflow...$s
stardewcraft.npc.rainy.clint: Today would be a good day to explore the mines... Who knows, you might find some rare ores.
stardewcraft.npc.rainy.penny: The raindrops are really loud on the metal roof of our trailer.#$e#...It's soothing, though.$h
stardewcraft.npc.rainy.emily: It never rains in Calico Desert... That's where my friend Sandy lives.#$e#I wish I could've visited her today.$s
stardewcraft.npc.rainy.haley: I spent all morning doing my hair... now the rain could mess it up.$s#$e#*sigh* ... Life is hard sometimes.
stardewcraft.npc.rainy.jodi: Did you wipe your boots off before coming in? Sorry... I just cleaned the floor.#$e#But you're always welcome in here! Heh.$h
stardewcraft.npc.rainy.sam: Rain muffles sound, so I can play my guitar louder without my mom getting mad. Hehe.$h
stardewcraft.npc.rainy.leah: Maybe I should cook something new and exciting today. Something spicy.
stardewcraft.npc.rainy.shane: Hmm... this weather makes me thirsty.$s
stardewcraft.npc.rainy.marnie: Hi @. You look like you're soaked...you poor thing!$h
stardewcraft.npc.rainy.elliott: Sometimes when I lay in bed I can hear a distant foghorn cut through the rain.#$b#But when I look out the window I see only a curtain of gray.
stardewcraft.npc.rainy.gus: There's nothing like a glass of dry red wine on a day like this, huh?#$e#I love my job. Hehehe.
stardewcraft.npc.rainy.dwarf: Rain... It's almost mythical to us. Some of us dwarves live our entire lives without ever experiencing it.
stardewcraft.npc.rainy.wizard: Stormy days are the only time I can commune with certain elementals.#$e#I don't expect you to understand.
stardewcraft.npc.rainy.harvey: Hi @! Er... Read anything interesting in the library lately?#$e#Heh. Well, um... I'll see you around then?
stardewcraft.npc.rainy.sandy: I heard it's raining back home. Is that why you came here?$h#$e#I kind of miss the rain, actually...$s
stardewcraft.npc.rainy.krobus: Ah, the sewers are flowing quickly today. It'll get nice and humid in here... Just how I like it.
stardewcraft.npc.rainy.leo: The valley is peaceful when it rains.#$e#To me... nature is someone I know, with different moods.
stardewcraft.npc.demetrius.resort_enteri: I already spotted a rare crab. This place is great.$h
stardewcraft.npc.demetrius.firstvisit_de: I heard you visited Calico Desert recently. How fascinating! I'm sure you observed many unique life forms on your trip.

stardewcraft.npc.vincent.reject_869: Oooh! Nice find!#$b#Mom wouldn't let me keep him, though...$s
stardewcraft.npc.vincent.sat_1: Dad's coming back soon!#$b#I hope he brings me some toys.$u
stardewcraft.npc.willy.acceptgift_(o)boo: Aye...  A timeless classic. Brings a tear to me eye, with every read. A fisherman can never have too many copies! Thank ye.$h
Thank ye! This'll be perfect winter reading. Ah, and it even smells of the sea...$h
stardewcraft.npc.willy.acceptgift_(o)ski: Ah, 'Bait And Bobber'... Every angler ought to have a subscription, but it costs a pretty penny. Taught me a lot of good fishin' tips over the years. Thanks!$h
stardewcraft.npc.willy.acceptgift_positi: Ah, this stuff warms the ol' bones. Thank you.
stardewcraft.npc.willy.accept_869: Ah... That's the perfect bait for a catfish I've been tryin' to catch!#$b#Here, let me trade you this for it. I'm not sure what it is, but it washed up on the beach not too long ago.#$b#Somethin' tells me you could use it, lad.^Somethin' tells me you could use it, miss.
stardewcraft.npc.willy.fullcrabpond: *sniff*... Ah... That old familiar scent. You've been raisin' crabs, haven't ya?#$b#Yer a ${man^lady}$ after me own heart, @. Hah!$h#$b#Here, take this. I found it on the beach... Been savin' it fer a special occasion. It's not every day I discover a fellow crab enthusiast! [797]
stardewcraft.npc.willy.movieinvitation: Ah... a movie. That's kind of ye, lad.^Ah... a movie. That's kind of ye, miss.#$b#I'll just finish me pipe, and head over.
stardewcraft.npc.wizard.acceptgift_(o)st: Ah, what do we have here? A rare and potent elixir, it seems. Yes, this will make a fine addition to my reagent chest.
stardewcraft.npc.wizard.accept_868: Ah... an arctic shard.#$b#A most powerful substance, indeed, and potently infused with the element of ice.#$b#I'll take it, if you don't mind.#$b#...#$b#...Erm...You're still here. Oh. You want something?#$b#...Take this.
stardewcraft.npc.wizard.movieinvitation: Hmm... I suppose I could accompany you... yes. Once you've arrived, I shall appear. Farewell.
stardewcraft.npc.wizard.roommates_krobus: It will be a challenge, to live with one such as Krobus. But richly rewarding to both parties, I'm sure.#$e#I admit, I am most interested to see the outcome of such an unusual friendship.
event.evelyn_garden_pot.farm: It was a lovely walk out here... I haven't seen this old farm in a long time.$s#$b#It looks even better than I remember!$h
event.evelyn_garden_pot.gift: Here, I brought you a little something.#$b#It's a gift... from one gardener to another.$h
event.evelyn_garden_pot.usage: These pots are really handy. You can use them to grow crops from any season, wherever you place them!#$b#They also make a lovely decoration anywhere around the farm.
event.evelyn_garden_pot.recipe: If you need more, they're really easy to make, too... here, I've got an old magazine clipping with instructions.
event.evelyn_garden_pot.learned: Learned how to craft a 'Garden Pot'
event.evelyn_garden_pot.goodbye: Well, I'd better go. George gets grumpy if he doesn't have his oatmeal on time...#$b#You have a great day, honey!$h
item.stardewcraft.garden_pot.desc: Grows crops from any season, wherever it is placed.
event.pierre.16.found_it: Wha...? How did you find that?!$4
event.pierre.16.question: Promise me you won't tell anyone about this.
event.pierre.16.choice.secret_safe: Your secret is safe with me.
event.pierre.16.choice.tell_wife: Your wife deserves to know about this.
event.pierre.16.new_hiding_spot: *grumble*...now I have to find a new hiding spot...*grumble*$u
stardewcraft.npc.schedule.pierre.fri.000: I've been working hard all week. I deserve a little relaxation on a Friday night.
stardewcraft.npc.schedule.pierre.desert_: As a shopkeeper, I find it interesting to see how other people run their shops.#$e#*whisper* Don't tell Sandy, but my grocery selection blows hers out of the water!
